en.usage.overview.antigravity_notice_body: Antigravity transcripts don't record real usage numbers. These counts are estimated from text length (~4 chars/token) and don't reflect Gemini's prompt-cache discount, so treat them as an upper bound, not a billing figure.
en.usage.overview.devin_notice_body: Devin reports real local token counts, but swe-2, swe-2-high and compactor have no pricing data in this build, so they are excluded from dollar estimates. A $0 figure does not mean the usage was free.
en.usage.overview.week_cross_month_hint: This week spans two calendar months, so its total is not directly comparable with a single month's usage

en.trend.monitor.label: Usage Trend
en.trend.zoom.desc: Hover any bar to inspect tokens, cost and conversations. Switch granularity to drill from months down to half-hours.
en.trend.zoom.insight.empty: A quiet stretch. Not a single token crossed the wire.
en.trend.zoom.insight.calm: Light touch. The model mostly sat on standby, waking only when you reached for it.
en.trend.zoom.insight.steady: A steady rhythm across {{active}} active stretches, cresting at {{peak}}. The kind of pace that ships things without drama.
en.trend.zoom.insight.heavy: Heavy lifting: {{active}} stretches running hot, peaking at {{peak}}. This is output from someone who manufactures momentum instead of waiting for it.
en.trend.zoom.insight.massive: Industrial scale. A {{peak}} peak and throughput that never cools. At this volume you are not using the model, you are running a foundry.

en.heatmap.3d.modal.ai.eval.default: You keep showing up and moving forward. Every small point of activity records another moment of thought and exploration. Over time, those sparks gather into a body of work that is uniquely yours.
en.heatmap.3d.modal.ai.eval.peak: This year, your token activity reached an exceptional level. You repeatedly turned complex ideas into concrete results with remarkable focus and momentum — a clear sign of sustained creative drive.
en.heatmap.3d.modal.ai.eval.heavy: Exceptional continuous output. Your accumulated tokens reflect an enormous volume of research, creation, and problem-solving. This sustained pace shows impressive focus and execution.
en.heatmap.3d.modal.ai.eval.core: Highly resilient long-term commitment. Over the past year, you maintained a strong and consistent rhythm, steadily turning AI-assisted work into durable results. You are a true productivity cornerstone.
en.heatmap.3d.modal.ai.eval.steady: Steady and focused progress. Every token marks another step in turning ideas into useful work. This consistent rhythm is how lasting expertise is built.
en.heatmap.3d.voxel.joke.1: 🔥 Extremely crazy! Produced {{value}} tokens! Are you training a large language model or writing a compiler by hand?
en.heatmap.3d.voxel.joke.2: 🚀 Epic output! Total {{value}} tokens. Today's production can circle the earth once, even the AI is amazed by you!
en.heatmap.3d.voxel.joke.3: ⚡ Critical Day! {{value}} tokens. Code is gushing out, and the keyboard is starting to smoke!
en.heatmap.3d.voxel.level3: ⚡ Productivity explosion ({{value}} tokens)! High efficiency and focus, keep up this peak state!
en.heatmap.3d.voxel.level2: 🌱 Getting into the groove ({{value}} tokens)! Steady output, every keystroke is contributing to the architecture.
en.heatmap.3d.voxel.level1: 🍃 Every drop counts ({{value}} tokens). Tiny commits are investments in the future, embrace compound interest!
en.heatmap.3d.voxel.level0: 💤 Recharging. On days without coding, inspiration grows silently.

zh.trend.monitor.label: 使用趋势
zh.trend.zoom.desc: 悬停任意柱子查看 token、成本与对话数。切换粒度可从月份下钻到半小时。
zh.trend.zoom.insight.empty: 一段安静的时光，没有一个 token 流过。
zh.trend.zoom.insight.calm: 轻描淡写。模型大多在待命，只在你需要时才醒来搭把手。
zh.trend.zoom.insight.steady: {{active}} 个活跃时段里节奏平稳，峰值 {{peak}}。是那种不声不响就把事情交付掉的节奏。
zh.trend.zoom.insight.heavy: 火力全开：{{active}} 个时段持续高热，峰值冲到 {{peak}}。这是自己制造势能、而非等待灵感的人的产出。
zh.trend.zoom.insight.massive: 工业级别。{{peak}} 的峰值，吞吐从不降温。到这个量级，你已经不是在用模型，而是在运营一座工厂。

zh.heatmap.3d.modal.ai.eval.default: 您一直在持续行动、不断向前。每一个微小的活跃点，都记录着一次思考与探索。点滴星火终会汇聚成只属于您的成果。
zh.heatmap.3d.modal.ai.eval.peak: 这一年中，您的 Token 活跃度达到了非凡水平。您持续以高度专注和强劲动能，把复杂想法转化为具体成果，展现出持久的创造力。
zh.heatmap.3d.modal.ai.eval.heavy: 卓越的持续输出。累积的 Token 记录了大量研究、创作与问题解决过程。这样的稳定节奏展现出令人印象深刻的专注力与执行力。
zh.heatmap.3d.modal.ai.eval.core: 极具韧性的长期投入。在过去的一年中，您始终保持着稳定而高效的节奏，不断把 AI 协作转化为持久成果，是当之无愧的核心生产力。
zh.heatmap.3d.modal.ai.eval.steady: 踏实而专注地持续前进。每一次 Token 的递增，都代表您又把一个想法转化成了有价值的成果。持久的专业能力，正是在这样的稳定节奏中积累起来的。
zh.heatmap.3d.voxel.joke.1: 🔥 极度疯狂！产出 {{value}} tokens！你是在疯狂训练大模型，还是手撸了一个编译器？
zh.heatmap.3d.voxel.joke.2: 🚀 史诗级输出！共 {{value}} tokens。今日产出可绕地球一圈，AI 都在为你惊叹！
zh.heatmap.3d.voxel.joke.3: ⚡ 爆击日！{{value}} tokens。代码如泉涌，键盘已经开始冒烟了！
zh.heatmap.3d.voxel.level3: ⚡ 生产力大爆发（{{value}} tokens）！高效专注的黄金时刻，继续保持这个巅峰状态！
zh.heatmap.3d.voxel.level2: 🌱 渐入佳境（{{value}} tokens）！稳步产出，每一次敲击键盘都是在为大厦添砖加瓦。
zh.heatmap.3d.voxel.level1: 🍃 聚沙成塔（{{value}} tokens）。微小的提交也是对未来的投资，保持复利的力量！
zh.heatmap.3d.voxel.level0: 💤 养精蓄锐。在不写代码的日子里，灵感也在悄悄生长。
